scope: Pose-only finger repair using the user-approved source-relative palm-width closure on all ordinary two-bone fingers. All suits have full offline regressions; native visual review is representative, not every suit. Native evidence is capped at two images per representative; a crop pair shows one pose, while runs without a crop show the two requested gameplay frames.
